title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1022 | 毒猴现身、小飞象章鱼、翻筋斗蛇
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐒 隐身近百年的小毒猴在印尼班加岛现身，大眼睛红棕毛，咬一口竟然有毒！
🐙 深海科学家偶遇超可爱的小飞象章鱼！八条胳膊加两只垂耳鳍，像迪士尼的小飞象！
🐍 小蛇遇到危险会“翻筋斗”逃跑，像车轮一样滚走，时速最快能到 8 英里！

📖 Word of the day: cartwheel（侧手翻）

🎮 小挑战：今天把单词 cartwheel 教给一个人，再和他一起翻个侧手翻——翻不起来，在草地上滚一圈也算！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐒 A tiny venomous monkey thought to be gone for nearly a hundred years shows up again on Indonesia's Bangka island — huge eyes, reddish brown fur, and a bite with venom!
🐙 Deep sea scientists just met the cutest Dumbo octopus! Eight arms and two floppy ear flaps, just like Dumbo the elephant!
🐍 Little snakes roll away from danger like wheels, flipping head over tail at almost eight miles per hour!

📖 Word of the day: cartwheel

🎮 Tiny challenge: teach one person the word cartwheel today, and try one cartwheel together! If you cannot do one yet, rolling on soft grass totally counts!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. cartwheel（侧手翻）
a fun sideways roll, hands first, then feet, then hands
例：do a cartwheel（翻一个侧手翻）

2. venom（毒液）
a poison some animals use to protect themselves
例：venom in a bite（咬一口就有毒）

3. loris（懒猴）
a small furry animal with huge eyes that moves very slowly
例：a sleepy loris（一只困困的懒猴）

4. flap（拍打；垂瓣）
a flat piece that moves up and down
例：ear flaps（垂耳鳍）
